svg.aria-label: Sorting state by where its truth lives: six questions asked in order, each yes answer mapped to a kind of state and the tool that should own it

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Where should this state live? Ask in order.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The first yes wins. Most pain comes from keeping server state in a client store.
